title: PHP daemon image digests
description: Content digest of every newrelic/php-daemon image published for a release, newest release first.

first_image_version.description: The first image tag that was published. A tag below it has no official image; a tag at or above it that is not listed in images is missing.

version.description: Image tag, which is the agent version without the build number.

digest.description: Digest of the tag (the multi-platform index), as used by docker pull newrelic/php-daemon@<digest>.

pushed.description: UTC time the registry reports for the last push of the tag.

platforms.description: Digest of the image of each platform.
